mapper.sql: bui.id, bui.org_id, bui.region_id, bui.role_group_id, bui.login_id, bui.login_pwd, bui.name, bui.phone, bui.head_url, bui.show_state, bui.add_user, bui.add_time, bui.user_type, bui.update_user, bui.update_time, bui.last_login_time, bui.last_update_pwd, bui.head_url, bui.employed_status, bui.must_update_pwd
mapper.select: select , bmi1.id as organi_id, bmi1.name as organi_name, bri.id as rol_id, bri.name as rol_name, bmi.id as rol_menu_id, bmi.parent_id as rol_menu_parent_id, bmi.name as rol_menu_name, bmi.open_url as rol_menu_open_url, bmi.is_frame as rol_menu_is_frame, bmi.order_num as rol_menu_order_num, bmi.is_display as rol_menu_is_display, region.id as reg_id, region.name as reg_name, region.full_name as reg_full_name from base_user_info bui left join base_organization_info bmi1 on bui.org_id = bmi1.id left join base_region_info region on region.id = bui.region_id join base_role_group brg on brg.id = bui.role_group_id join base_role_group_link brgl on brgl.group_id = brg.id join base_role_info bri on bri.id = brgl.role_id left join base_role_menu brm on bri.id = brm.role_id left join base_menu_info bmi on brm.menu_id = bmi.id where bui.login_id = #{loginId}

SELECT , bmi.id as organi_id, bmi.parent_id as organi_parent_id, bmi.name as organi_name, bmi.levels as organi_levels, brg.id as rol_group_id, brg.name as rol_group_name, region.id as reg_id, region.name as reg_name, region.parent_id as reg_parent_id FROM base_user_info bui left join base_role_group brg ON brg.id = bui.role_group_id left join base_organization_info bmi ON bmi.id = bui.org_id left join base_region_info region on region.id = bui.region_id
and bui.org_id in (WITH RECURSIVE child_nodes AS (SELECT bmi.id FROM base_organization_info bmi WHERE id = #{orgId} UNION SELECT bmi2.id FROM base_organization_info bmi2 JOIN child_nodes pn ON pn.id = bmi2.parent_id) SELECT * FROM child_nodes)
and bui.name like CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY bui.add_time DESC, bui.id desc

SELECT
FROM base_user_info bui WHERE org_id = #{orgId} order by bui.id desc

select , bmi1.id as organi_id, bmi1.name as organi_name, bmi1.levels as organi_levels, bmi1.type as organi_type, brg.id as rol_group_id, brg.name as rol_group_name, region.id as reg_id, region.name as reg_name from base_user_info bui left join base_organization_info bmi1 on bui.org_id = bmi1.id left join base_region_info region on region.id = bui.region_id left join base_role_group brg on bui.role_group_id = brg.id where bui.login_id = #{loginId}

select , bmi1.id as organi_id, bmi1.name as organi_name, bmi1.levels as organi_levels, bmi1.type as organi_type, brg.id as rol_group_id, brg.name as rol_group_name, region.id as reg_id, region.name as reg_name from base_user_info bui left join base_organization_info bmi1 on bui.org_id = bmi1.id left join base_region_info region on region.id = bui.region_id left join base_role_group brg on bui.role_group_id = brg.id where bui.phone = #{phone}

select , bmi1.id as organi_id, bmi1.name as organi_name, bmi1.levels as organi_levels, bmi1.type as organi_type, brg.id as rol_group_id, brg.name as rol_group_name, region.id as reg_id, region.name as reg_name from base_user_info bui left join base_organization_info bmi1 on bui.org_id = bmi1.id left join base_region_info region on region.id = bui.region_id left join base_role_group brg on bui.role_group_id = brg.id where bui.id = #{id}
